summary: Eight games were played, with Denver rallying from 23 down to beat New Orleans 141-135 in overtime behind 42 points from Jamal Murray and a 35-point triple-double from Nikola Jokić. Devin Booker scored 43 in Phoenix's 131-122 win over Golden State, and Joel Embiid had a triple-double in Philadelphia's win over Milwaukee. Three games were decided by five points or fewer.

games.headline: Cavaliers hold off Nets 125-121 after leading by 22
games.story: Cleveland led 68-54 at the half and by 22 early in the fourth quarter at 104-82. Brooklyn outscored the Cavaliers 41-29 in the fourth and got within two points at 123-121 with 8 seconds left. Cleveland made two free throws with 5 seconds left to seal it. Michael Porter Jr. scored 28 for Brooklyn and Julius Randle added 23. Donovan Mitchell scored 22 for Cleveland, Jarrett Allen had 21 on 7-of-8 shooting, and Evan Mobley had 20 points and 10 rebounds.

games.headline: Booker scores 43 as Suns beat Warriors 131-122
games.story: Devin Booker scored 43 on 17-of-25 shooting, with 7 rebounds and 7 assists. Phoenix outscored Golden State 45-38 in the third quarter and took the lead for good at 76-75 with 5:32 left in that period. The Suns led by as many as 16 in the fourth. Yaxel Lendeborg scored 26 for Golden State and De'Anthony Melton added 25. Golden State was without Curry, Butler, Horford and Moody.

games.headline: Rockets beat Hawks 121-114, leading by as many as 20
games.story: Houston led 59-48 at the half and by 20 at 85-65 in the third quarter. Atlanta outscored the Rockets 33-29 in the fourth and got within five at 117-112 with 36 seconds left. Kevin Durant scored 22 for Houston, Reed Sheppard had 19 points and 7 assists with five threes, and Alperen Sengun had 17 points, 10 rebounds and 7 assists. Jalen Johnson had 26 points, 9 rebounds and 16 assists for Atlanta.

games.headline: Hornets hold off Heat 115-110 after 23-point lead
games.story: Charlotte led by as many as 23 in the third quarter and was ahead 96-75 after three. Miami outscored the Hornets 35-19 in the fourth and tied the game at 104 with 3:45 left. Charlotte then scored 11 of the next 17 points to close it out. Brandon Miller scored 34 on 10-of-29 shooting, including 11 made free throws. Davion Mitchell led Miami with 22 points and 10 assists.

games.headline: Embiid triple-double powers 76ers past Bucks 127-116
games.story: Joel Embiid had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists and made 12 of 14 free throws. The game was tied at 82 with 4:25 left in the third quarter, and Philadelphia took the lead for good at 83-82 on the next basket. The 76ers led by as many as 16 at 105-89 in the fourth. Jaylen Brown scored 27 and Tyrese Maxey 26 for Philadelphia. Jaime Jaquez Jr. led Milwaukee with 21 points, and Kel'el Ware had 19 points and 13 rebounds.

games.headline: Nuggets rally from 23 down, beat Pelicans 141-135 in OT
games.story: New Orleans led by as many as 23 in the second quarter and was ahead 73-57 at the half. Denver trailed 108-89 entering the fourth, outscored the Pelicans 37-18 in the period and tied the game at 126. Denver went ahead for good at 130-128 with 2:36 left in overtime and won the extra period 15-9. Jamal Murray scored 42 with eight threes, and Nikola Jokić had 35 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists. Trey Murphy III led New Orleans with 26.

games.headline: Spurs pull away from Mavericks, win 122-106
games.story: San Antonio led 68-60 at the half and took the lead for good at 89-87 with 1:09 left in the third quarter. The Spurs outscored Dallas 30-17 in the fourth and led by as many as 23. Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, 7 rebounds and 4 blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22, and De'Aaron Fox had 19 points and 9 assists. Sergio de Larrea led Dallas with 21 points. Dallas was without Aldama, Biberović, Flagg, Irving, Lively and Martin.

games.headline: Wizards hold off Bulls 124-120 after leading by 21
games.story: Washington outscored Chicago 40-20 in the third quarter to lead 97-82 after three, and led by 21 at 103-82 early in the fourth. Chicago scored 38 in the fourth and got within three with 23 seconds left, but never led in the period. Caleb Wilson had 30 points and 14 rebounds for Chicago. Trae Young scored 25 with 9 assists and went 9-of-9 at the line, and Kyshawn George had 22 points and 9 rebounds. Washington was without Dybantsa, Vukčević and Watkins.
